_comment: Recorded by scripts/benchmark.ps1 -Record on the development machine.
Machine-specific: these numbers mean nothing on different hardware, which is
why the gate is opt-in (-Gate) and never runs in CI.
tolerancePercent is set from observed run-to-run variance, not taste. The
3-page case is stable to about 3%; the 1000-page case swings 20% between
runs because it opens a 1.1 MB file. 25% still catches the class of
regression this exists for -- the translator change cost 80% of first-page
time -- while a tighter number would fire on noise, and a gate that cries
wolf gets ignored, which is worse than no gate.
firstPageMs carries a 210 ms cost from installing the QTranslator. That is
diagnosed but not fixed (docs/OPTIMISATION-PLAN.md). Do not re-record it away.
